text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines 
 the checklist
 I1 for temperature switches, which must be carried out on 
 an annually bases as indicated 
 by Y1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 31 Dec 2002, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Close manual 
 valve for pressure Switch line
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes,
Pressure tester, 
 Ohmmeter or multimeter.
Work to be carried out
Steps to Prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of setting values of the 
 temperature switch and record at MPRDS.
Disconnect temperature switch wires and isolate the wires 
 using tape.
Remove temperature switch and tak 
 it to lab.
Testing 
Procedure
Put the temperature switch 
 into the oven and connect ohmmeter leads to temperature switch 
 contact terminals.
Adjust the oven temperature to the correct value, wait 5 minutes using 
 ohmmeter check if contact change its situation.
If there is any error 
 adjust the contact and repeat step 2 until reach the correct value.
Return temperature switch to 
Service
Return temperature switch to service by removing the oven 
 tester and disconnect ohmmeter leads from the temperature switch terminal.
Return temperature
 switch back to its location.
Connect the temperature
 switch wires.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
